description.translate: Twelve sheets of paper will let me restore the sanctuary records. These are accounts of care given and people helped, not debts to be collected. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The Ranker asked me about binding captured power to its bearer. I taught him that such a bond needed a willing personal offering. He left that work unfinished, along with his promise to help this sanctuary. Strength taken from an enemy could not make that choice for him.
